svg.title: The Armoury — tech stack
svg.desc: World of Warcraft–style action bars of technology icons. Mobile: Flutter, Dart, Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Swift / SwiftUI, Android, iOS; Backend: Go, Gin, MySQL, TiDB, JWT, Docker, Render; Data & Cloud: Firebase, Odoo; Payments: Google Pay, Apple Pay, +8 more gateways; Tools: Git, Postman. Main weapons glow orange as legendary items.
